name: My Pet Nagato
source:
Main character makes Nagato look terrible, and it becomes the starting push to different kind of relations. He seeks a person to rely on, and Nagato is such a person. But she can't be everything he needs, so she agrees to follow protagonist's step by step instructions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
